- January 2022: 31 days (cumulative: 48)
- February 2022: 28 days (cumulative: 76)
- March 2022: 31 days (cumulative: 107)
- April 2022: 30 days (cumulative: 137)
- May 2022: 31 days (cumulative: 168)
- June 2022: 25 days needed (193 - 168 = 25)

Result: 2022-06-25
